executive_summary: Pre-flight simulation for PR-4082-FIREWALL-IAM concluded with verdict: BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT. Composite risk score: 100/100. Identified 2 security finding(s) across 9 affected asset(s). Deployment BLOCKED: Detected 1 CRITICAL security finding(s): [Cloud Privilege Escalation: Managed Policy 'AmazonS3FullAccess']. Critical security violations override numerical scores.

predicted_affected_assets.impact_description: Explicitly mapped security group 'sg-analytics-web-01' on workload 'eks-analytics-worker-pool' updated with unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 outbound egress
Business application 'Customer Telemetry & Analytics' hosted on impacted workload 'eks-analytics-worker-pool' is potentially exposed to compromise or service disruption

predicted_affected_assets.asset_name: Subnet: DMZ Public Web & Ingestion Subnet (10.100.4.0/24)
predicted_affected_assets.impact_description: Zone boundary potentially weakened by unrestricted egress rule on hosted workload 'eks-analytics-worker-pool'

Overprivileged policy attachment on 'role-analytics-ingestion-svc' satisfies CROSS_ZONE_IAM_PATH blast condition: potentially exposes sensitive data in 's3-enterprise-cui-vault' to cross-bucket read/write access if execution credentials are compromised
Sensitive data asset 'Corporate Restricted Financial & CUI Vault' (RESTRICTED_CUI_PII) stored in 's3-enterprise-cui-vault' is potentially exposed to unauthorized access, tampering, or exfiltration
KMS encryption key 'alias/apex-cui-financial-vault' protecting 's3-enterprise-cui-vault' is associated with potentially exposed data store

Overprivileged policy attachment on 'role-analytics-ingestion-svc' satisfies CAN_ACCESS blast condition: potentially exposes sensitive data in 's3-dev-staging-telemetry' to cross-bucket read/write access if execution credentials are compromised
Sensitive data asset 'Development Staging & Telemetry Storage' (INTERNAL_OPERATIONAL) stored in 's3-dev-staging-telemetry' is potentially exposed to unauthorized access, tampering, or exfiltration

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: AWS Security Group rule 'allow_outbound_webhook' on SG 'sg-analytics-web-01' allows egress to '0.0.0.0/0' on protocol 'tcp' ports 443-443. Enables unrestricted outbound network communication to any host on the public internet.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 (Rule 5.3) & NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AC-05
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Restrict cidr_blocks on 'allow_outbound_webhook' to specific target service CIDRs, VPC endpoints, or AWS Prefix Lists.

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Attaching broad managed policy 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess' to role 'role-analytics-ingestion-svc' grants unrestricted wildcard read/write/delete actions over AWS resources, including confidential CUI data assets in the enterprise vault.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: NIST SP 800-171 3.1.1 & CIS AWS Benchmark v1.4.0 (Rule 1.16)
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Replace 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess' with a customer-managed, least-privilege policy scoped to exact S3 bucket actions (e.g. s3:PutObject on telemetry staging).

pre_implementation_validation_plan.what_to_validate: Verify egress CIDR scoping on security group 'sg-analytics-web-01'
pre_implementation_validation_plan.expected_pass_criteria: Egress CIDR must be restricted to partner subnet, NOT 0.0.0.0/0

pre_implementation_validation_plan.what_to_validate: Verify attached policies on role 'role-analytics-ingestion-svc' adhere to least-privilege
pre_implementation_validation_plan.expected_pass_criteria: Role must NOT attach AmazonS3FullAccess or AdministratorAccess
